## TASK-017 - Model selected skills, roles and registry bindings

Create root binding input templates and source-backed instance records for installed memory, to-trd and Task capabilities, actual role pairs, governance/specification artifacts and factual registry metadata.

| Dependencies | TASK-016 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- Skill type, installed instance and its SKILL.md artifact are distinct; memory retrieval and TRD creation resolve in both capability directions.
- Bindings state that TRD creation does not create a Task; current role sources use exact AGENTS.md/ROLE.md pairs rather than the index.
- Host Director, confirmed manager and ordinary child are distinct; registry references never recursively load child vocabulary.

### Planned verification

- Inspect every seed binding against current installed files and exact source hashes.
- Run stale/missing-source, pair-authority, same-label project isolation and bidirectional capability queries.

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- Definition/graph/capability queries select the intended ontology interfaces; current-rule queries use current permitted source bytes and surface discrepancies.
- History/mixed routing uses the existing memory read interface or explicit unavailable/no-evidence output; ontology answers remain usable without that backend.
- No routing mode invokes a discovered skill or silently publishes anything.

### Planned verification

- Run the route intent matrix and conflict/current-source fixtures.
- Use an unavailable-memory fixture and verify independent ontology results and the exact historical-evidence limitation.
